description: The lane the Team Ops Board scheduled task executes: the Board runtime, Watchtower, the AI usage meter, the mail forwarder, and the Codex retention worker. Its included-path set is the one operations-lane-v1 and v2 were assembled from; this spec is the first machine-readable statement of it.

carried_forward_rationale.node_modules/yaml/: yaml runtime dependency; not tracked, and rebuilding it would need a registry the lane host is not required to reach.
carried_forward_rationale.ui-workspace/node_modules/: vite + @vitejs/plugin-react runtime closure. Deliberately the runtime closure only, not the build closure.
carried_forward_rationale.ui-workspace/apps/team-ops-board/dist/: gitignored vite output. Carry it forward only while no client source under ui-workspace/apps/team-ops-board/src (excluding src/server) has changed since the previous lane's commit; otherwise rebuild it and stage it as a fresh previous-lane input.
